name: Tourist Entry (CA-4)

requirements.blocker_text: El Salvador's Ministry of Foreign Affairs classifies nationalities into three visa categories: (A) visa-exempt (e.g. Germany, Australia, Argentina, Austria), (B) consular visa required, (C) requiring prior consultation/review before approval. Classification depends on both nationality and passport type (ordinary, diplomatic, official, service); the same country can fall into a different category in each of the four CA-4 states. El Salvador has been part of the CA-4 Border Control Agreement with Guatemala, Honduras, and Nicaragua since 2005, sharing a single visa classification framework and free movement across the bloc -- the standard 90-day tourist allowance is shared across all four countries, not reset by crossing between them.
requirements.fix_path: For Category B/C nationalities, apply for a consular or consulted visa through a Salvadoran diplomatic mission before travel.

evidence_required.document: Tourism card (required for some visa-exempt nationalities, e.g. Australia)

sources.title: Ministerio de Relaciones Exteriores de El Salvador -- visa categories (A/B/C), CA-4 free-movement framework, nationality- and passport-type-based classification

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (El Salvador). El Salvador's own migration authority hosts a downloadable visa-exempt/visa-required country list, but the list itself is an external file this build could not access directly -- so a full named nationality list is not asserted here, only the category structure and CA-4 framework, which are confirmed.
